content:
maria: T-minus 45 until the EU change window. Quick preflight checklist before we wake the deploy bot and start canary traffic.
maria: We're pinned to v3.2.1-rc5 for this rollout, canary plan 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~20m. Soft freeze starts in 20m, hard freeze in 5m. Exceptions = security hotfix only.
deploy-bot: Pinned version=v3.2.1-rc5 to canary group. snapshot=snap-2026-03-21-279145. Estimated warmup 3m, drain-time ~2m.
sam: I can own smoke and metrics. I'll run smoke scripts and watch latency/error SLOs.
sam: Primary gates: 99th latency < 220ms, p50 < 80ms, error rate < 0.2% for canary duration. If breached, I call rollback.
jules: I'll be on rollback lane and ops. If we need to cut, plan is v3.2.0 fallback. Make rollback manual (no auto) unless error>1% for 3m.
kaito: Infra check: autoscaler targets healthy, GPU pool prewarmed. Prewarm command: `kubectl exec -it smoke-runner -- /scripts/prewarm.sh` — prewarming started.
olivia: PM note: small change in reranker scoring — include line in release notes. Docs freeze? soft freeze OK, docs team notified.
maria: Freeze rules: soft-freeze = block feature merges, allow docs edits; hard-freeze blocks all non-critical merges. Exception tracker: https://go/release-excepts — add any exemption with owner + reason.
sam: Starting smoke run now. Running `./tools/smoke.sh --targets=generate,embed --samples=50`
sam: Smoke output (snippet): ```ok: /generate latency=95ms tokens=42
ok: /embed latency=20ms
summary: 50/50 passed, avg latency 73ms``` 
deploy-bot: Canary traffic shift: initiating 10% -> job_id=cb-2791456789-1. Logs available at https://ci/release/2791456789/canary1
jules: Dashboard pushed: releases/279145-smoke. Added alert rules: canary_error_rate > 0.5% for 2m, canary_99th > 250ms for 2m.
kaito: Rollback playbook (one-liners): `rbctl rollback --target v3.2.0 --reason "canary spike"` and `@deploy-bot rollback v3.2.0` to trigger immediate re-pin.
maria: If we need to abort, use channel #release-war-room + call via phone tree. Owners: maria (release lead), sam (oncall), jules (sre rollback), kaito (infra runbook), olivia (PM comms).
olivia: I'll post a short release-note blurb to #marketing when we're at 50% green. Draft: "v3.2.1-rc5: improved reranker scoring, latency improvements, minor bugfixes."
sam: Canary 10% steady for 6m, metrics look clean. p99=120ms, errors=0.08%.
maria: Proceed to 50% when ready. Reminder: monitor token-cost anomaly and embeddings CPU.
sam: Kicking 50% now. `deploy-bot` please progress to cb-2791456789-2
deploy-bot: Canary job cb-2791456789-1 completed. Progressing to 50% -> job_id=cb-2791456789-2. ETA 6m.
jules: Small hiccup alert at t+3m: brief spike to p99=270ms for ~30s, correlated with background compaction on infra node. Observed errors stayed <0.3%.
sam: Verified spike coincided with node compaction; metrics returned to normal in 90s. No rollback. Marking incident as transient.
maria: Good catch — add compaction schedule note to postmortem. Continue to 100% if stable for next 10m.
kaito: I've moved the compaction window out of the next 2h to avoid repeats.
olivia: Marketing blurb posted and docs updated. I'll hold final announcement until 30m stable.
maria: We're at 100% traffic now, all health checks green. Post-launch tasks: monitor for 30m, collect traffic-sample for perf eval, close change window in infra console.
sam: Setting oncall watches: escalate if error_rate > 0.5% for 5m. I'll drop a summary in #eng-sre in 30m.
jules: Leaving a note: rollback artifacts and snapshot IDs saved under s3://releases/2791456789/artifacts
maria: Thanks team. Closing the loop: freeze lifted in 30m after stable window. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout complete. Final state: deployed v3.2.1-rc5 -> production. Jobs: [cb-1, cb-2]. log=https://ci/release/2791456789/final
sam: Quick thumbs: :thumbsup:
maria: And done. Great job everyone — will file a short retrospective and keep the compaction runbook updated.
